text:
Evan: Hi finance, quick issue from last night's vendor dinner with partner — venue charged the corpcard once as a lump (total $1,120.75) but the PDF folio they gave is itemized per table and includes a VAT number missing on the invoice. I paid nothing OOP but need to split personal items and client-covered line.
Marta - Manager: Approved splitting. Evan pls list which line items are personal vs business (client covered).
Evan: Sure — table A (team) food $480.00, table B (partners) food $420.00, shared dessert $45.50, service charge 10% $115.25, tip cash left $60.00 (I gave cash). Some team members had bottles ordered personal (line items 12-14 total $0 for team? actually $40.00 personal).
Priya - Finance: If the corpcard already paid the venue, we need the vendor folio + invoice with VAT/TAX ID to treat as business. For the personal bottle $40 we will create a personal split and require repayment or payroll deduction. For the cash tip $60: tips are non-reimbursable unless pre-approved; if you left cash voluntarily it's personal. Did venue provide a merchant invoice with tax ID?
Evan: Invoice.pdf attached in Concur. It shows company name but no VAT number. I asked venue to email a corrected invoice with VAT/TAX ID. I put Concur expense ID EXP-2026-1022-7060 and added notes: "split: partners cover table B; personal bottles $40 to be returned; cash tip personal".
VendorOpsBot: Vendor ticket VEND-9023 opened requesting corrected invoice for VAT/TAX ID from GourmetHall. ETA 48hrs.
Priya - Finance: Good. Workflow: since corpcard paid the whole amount, finance will: 1) allocate partner-covered portion as billable to Sales (we'll create internal chargeback), 2) mark team food portion as business and reimburse as already paid by corpcard, 3) create a personal charge for $40 bottles and mark for collection. We will not reimburse cash tip $60.
Marta - Manager: Confirmed. I approve marking $40 as personal and arranging collection. Also confirm Sales gets billed for partner table $420 + proportional tax/service.
Evan: Vendor emailed corrected invoice with VAT GB123456789, attached to Concur. Updated EXP-2026-1022-7060.
Priya - Finance: Received corrected invoice. Will process allocation now and create chargeback to Sales under code `BILLABLE_EVENTS`. We will post a comment here once posted and set the personal bottle $40 to payroll recovery code `EMP_REPAY`.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-1022-7060 processed by finance at 2026-10-23 09:12 UTC. Status: chargeback to Sales created (CB-3309). Personal charge $40 set to EMP_REPAY for next payroll cycle. Tip $60 marked non-reimbursable.
Evan: Thanks all. One ask: can CardOps whitelist the vendor descriptor? Venue told me their acquirer descriptor sometimes shows as "GH-FOOD" which confuses Concur mapping.
Priya - Finance: Noted. @VendorOpsBot please include mapping request in VEND-9023. We'll also request CardOps to map GH-FOOD to GourmetHall.
VendorOpsBot: Mapping request added to VEND-9023. CardOps notified.
Marta - Manager: Closing on my side once Sales confirms chargeback.
Priya - Finance: I'll post final status once Sales acknowledges CB-3309. Closing thread when payroll recovery scheduled. :white_check_mark:
